# Generated by houston. Do not edit by hand -- re-run `houston up`.
services:
  rocketchat:
    image: rc
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:3100:3000
  mongodb: null
  prometheus:
    image: docker.io/prom/prometheus:v3.4.2
    command:
    - --config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    - --web.enable-lifecycle
    - --storage.tsdb.retention.time=15d
    - --web.enable-remote-write-receiver
    volumes:
    - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
    - ./monitoring/file_sd_configs:/etc/prometheus/file_sd_configs:ro
    - prometheus_tsdb:/prometheus
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:9090:9090
    restart: unless-stopped
  grafana:
    image: docker.io/grafana/grafana:12.0.2
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: admin
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED: 'true'
      GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_ROLE: Viewer
      GF_SECURITY_ALLOW_EMBEDDING: 'true'
    volumes:
    - ./monitoring/grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
    - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/dashboards:ro
    - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:5050:3000
    depends_on:
    - prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
  node-exporter:
    image: docker.io/prom/node-exporter:v1.9.1
    command:
    - --path.procfs=/host/proc
    - --path.sysfs=/host/sys
    - --path.rootfs=/rootfs
    - --collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(sys|proc|dev|host|etc)($$|/)
    volumes:
    - /proc:/host/proc:ro
    - /sys:/host/sys:ro
    - /:/rootfs:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
  mongodb-exporter:
    image: docker.io/percona/mongodb_exporter:0.43.1
    command:
    - --mongodb.uri=mongodb://mongodb:27017/?directConnection=true
    - --collect-all
    - --compatible-mode
    depends_on:
    - mongodb
    restart: unless-stopped
  loki:
    image: docker.io/grafana/loki:3.6
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/config.yaml -config.expand-env=true
    user: '0'
    volumes:
    - ./monitoring/loki/config.yaml:/etc/loki/config.yaml:ro
    - loki_data:/data/loki:rw
    restart: unless-stopped
  opentelemetry-logs-collector:
    image: docker.io/otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.143.0
    command:
    - --config=/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml
    user: '0'
    volumes:
    - ./monitoring/otel/config.yaml:/etc/otel-collector-config.yaml:ro
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    - /var/lib/docker/containers:/hostfs/storage:ro
    depends_on:
    - loki
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  prometheus_tsdb:
    driver: local
  grafana_data:
    driver: local
  loki_data:
    driver: local
